test_title: PYST 48: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing the north. F sits to the immediate left of A. C sits third to the left of D. C is an immediate neighbour of A. B sits to the immediate left of E.

How many people sit between E and C?
solution:
Given: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

F sits to the immediate left of A.

C sits third to the left of D.

C is an immediate neighbour of A.

B sits to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d6eb1350691bd334380e95b07750367cfed3241a30e1015a6f62204c82d9225.png] 

Between C and E are B → only 1 person.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
